All **40 additions / 15,983,134 bytes** were read back through immutable GitHub file downloads and match the local bytes; all **2,556 parent files** remain unchanged. Temporary authenticated download manifests were deleted. Authentic remote commit bytes were hash-matched and imported under the actual identity; local checkout is clean.

The evidence archive restores exactly: **18 parts / 15,483,218 archive bytes / 414 members / 167,310,502 member bytes**, with joined/part/member hashes, exact membership and ZIP CRCs verified. No archived script or product rerun occurred. The earlier first blob-readback attempt incorrectly parsed the connector's normalized Markdown as JSON; that preparation error is retained separately. It changed no tree/ref or product evidence; all files subsequently received full immutable-download verification.

On the actual published core, the unchanged documentation checker passes **29 sources / 233 sections / 208 documents / 1,671 local links / 92 anchors**, zero failures. Root source/archive metadata validation passes **53 checks**, exit 0, with all **2,596 core files / 524,662,681 bytes** stable. Actual validation ran **2026-10-26T21:58:23.893591+00:00–2026-10-26T21:58:26.312855+00:00**, inside the active window, on CPython 3.12.14. Result SHA-256 `0941b4f19571d664ecf19e682af34cdc731150b76282e9e4e97ef62fdfef4d8c`. Whitespace checks pass. Defined credential patterns have no matches; no universal secret-absence claim is made.

Root window 6428198041 is now closed. Root, capture and lifetime reviewers pause all commands and file writes. After this comment is posted, only `/root/source_recovery` may run the independent final core/source/evidence/publication metadata audit, writing solely to external `c047-final-review/`, expiring **2026-10-26T22:19:09.000Z**. It may read ZIP members and CRCs, but may not extract/execute archived code, import/run product code, rerun the original pair, change source/Markdown or mutate remote state. Bind current remote core/ref/tree, all parent/core files, archive and direct review copies, current lifetime source/data proof and scope, exact reviews/receipts, and actual validation stability. Keep output compact and disclose earlier source acquisition/pair-audit roles. Root resumes only after explicit audit closure and pause.
